title: Subbat Alaiya Ki Sada
body:
Haye Zehra (Sa) (x6)
Aaj Bhi Kaano Mein Hai Subbat Alaiya Ki Sada.. (x2)
Rooh Ko Tadpa Raha Hai Fatima (Sa) Ka Marsiya
1) Din Pe Hota Wo Sitam Toh Din Bhi Raat Aata Nazar ... (2)
Baade Mursal Fatema (Sa) Par Jo Sitam Dhaya Gaya...
2) Kham Qamar Hai Hogayi Hai Phasliya Bhi Choor Choor ... (2)
Sans Lena Bhi Nabi Zadi Ka Dubhar Ho Gaya...
3) Gasibo Ne Gasb Karli (Sa) Ki Milkiyat... (2)
Zere Turbat Khoon Rote Hai Mohammed (Sa) Mustafa...
4) Baap Ke Matam Mein Rone Bhi Nahi Dete Shaqi ... (2)
Kis Qadar Mazloom Hai Kaun O Maka Ki Malika...
5) Madare Hasnain Se Mangwaye Jaate Hai Gawah ... (2)
Kalmay -e- Tauheed Ranjeeda Hai Wehdat Hai Khafa...
6) Phar Kar Tahrir-e-Mursal Ahle Kee'n Haste Rahe ... (2)
Aur Sare Darbar Qurane Mubi'n Rota Raha...
7) Pis Gayi Darwaza -o- Diwar Mein Binte Rasool (Sa) ... (2)
Haye Mohsin Ki Shahadat Hogayi Waa Ghurbata...
8) Bazm -e- Gham Awaaz Deti Hai Musalman -o- Suno ... (2)
Bint -e- Ahmad Ki Shahadat Par Hai Yeh Matam Bapa...
9) Mustafa (As) Ki Ladali Duniya Se Rukasat Hogayi ... (2)
Hogaye Be-Aasra Shabbir O Shabbar Murtaza (As) ...
10) Dard Ka Mahol Hai Ab Bhi Madine Mein Azim ... (2)
Hai Nishana Zulm Ka Ab Bhi Mazar -e- Fatema (Sa)...
